extracted.intended_audience: authors of Bridges papers and users of the Bridges Archive (researchers, librarians, and conference attendees)
extracted.subtask_description: Site-level policies and practical guidance for hosting, citing, reusing, and correcting papers in the Bridges Conference online archive. Applies to authors whose papers are in the Archive and to users who download/cite those papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author copyright retention
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors retain copyright for the text and images in the papers on this website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors keep ownership of their work; the Archive does not claim transfer of copyright. (Original wording: 'Authors retain copyright for the text and images in the papers on this website.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Permissions granted to Bridges Organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors grant the Bridges Organization the right to host their papers here and use their content to promote the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Archive has the nonexclusive right to host papers and use their content for conference promotion. This is distinct from copyright transfer; authors still own their work but permit hosting/use for promotion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-use of material requires contacting the paper's author
rubrics_metrics.description: If you wish to re-use material from a Bridges paper, please contact that paper's author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Archive directs users to obtain reuse permission from the original author rather than assuming reuse rights; contact details are expected to be sought from the author.

rubrics_metrics.name: BibTeX and downloadable bibliographies
rubrics_metrics.description: All papers offer a downloadable file suitable for use in BibTeX. You can also download a master bibliography file of all Bridges papers, and a PDF document containing every paper published here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should cite papers using the provided BibTeX entries. The site provides both per-paper BibTeX files and aggregate bibliographic resources (master bibliography and combined-PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic accuracy and error reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: We make an effort to guarantee that bibliographic information is as accurate as possible. If you see an error, please contact us at bridges@bridgesmathart.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Archive requests that users report metadata errors to the given email so they can be corrected; this is the prescribed channel for corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format of older papers and replacement policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers published prior to 2005 were scanned from printed proceedings. If you are the author of one of these papers and would like to replace the scanned version with a native PDF, please contact us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Older items may be scanned images of proceedings; authors may request a native-PDF replacement by contacting the Archive, implying a process exists to update files upon author request.
